title: Electrocatalytic hydrogenation of quinoxaline using CoO/NF in organic molecular redox flow batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01363A, Paper
Xin Zheng, Bowen Chen, Hanyu Li, Fangcheng Qiu, Xue Han, Shaowen Tan, Siyi Chen, Shengping Wang
CoO/NF as hydrogenation electrocatalyst exhibits excellent conversion rates of quinoxaline and selectivity of tetrahydroquinoxaline, which weakens hydrogen evolution through Co2+ site-specific adsorption and hydrogen transfer pathway reconstruction.
